It exists for builders who want to one day own their own real-world mansion — not through hype or gambling, but through discipline, alignment, and time. events.text: Why We Lock Locking is one of the smartest advantages in crypto. Not because it sounds disciplined — but because it removes the behaviors that prevent real outcomes. Most people don’t fail because they chose the wrong asset. They fail because they couldn’t stay aligned long enough. They exit early. They react to noise. They trade long-term outcomes for short-term stimulation. Locking eliminates that entire category of mistakes. Once tokens are locked, the decision is settled. There is nothing to babysit. Nothing to react to. The time horizon is set. That matters, because mansions are not built in moments. They are built by holding through: - steady progress - long-term execution - periods where work matters more than attention Locking enforces that consistency when motivation fades and noise spikes. It also simplifies life. Locked positions aren’t constantly signing transactions or interacting with contracts. Exposure drops. Mental overhead disappears. Attention returns to building income, skills, leverage, and health — the things that actually produce a mansion. Locking also makes commitment visible. When supply is locked, it isn’t being recycled into impulsive decisions. It’s removed from circulation with intent. That clarity attracts builders and filters out tourists automatically. events.text: Mansioncoin Security and Custody Guide The Builder’s Standard $MANSION is a long-term position. That means your first job is not trading. It’s custody. If you want the mansion life, you have to survive the part that ruins people: exposure. Wallet security is not about being “smart.” It’s about refusing to give your holdings access to danger. This guide is the standard. Follow it exactly. The first law is separation. A vault wallet is not a wallet you “use.” A vault wallet is a wallet you protect. You build two wallets. The Vault Wallet holds your long-term $MANSION. It is cold storage. It is the vault. It is the reserve. The Hot Wallet is for activity. Swaps, links, websites, mints, anything that requires connecting. The Vault Wallet never touches any of that. If a website needs a wallet connection, it gets the Hot Wallet. The Vault Wallet stays untouched. That one decision eliminates entire categories of risk. The second law is custody of the recovery phrase. Your recovery phrase is the master key. It is the only thing that matters when everything else breaks. You secure it like a deed. Write it down physically. Make two copies. Store them in two separate secure locations you will still control years from now. You keep it offline permanently. No photos. No notes app. No cloud storage. No email. No printing shop. events.text: Android update. This morning, Google Play suspended UpRock’s Android listing following a policy review flagged under its Malware policy. UpRock continues to work for existing Android users. iOS and desktop remain available, while new Android downloads are temporarily unavailable through Google Play. At this stage, Google has not provided enough technical detail for us to identify exactly which SDK, third-party service, behavior, or implementation triggered the decision. UpRock uses several established third-party SDKs and monetization partners, many of which have been live in the app for some time. Rather than speculate, we’ve asked Google for the specific technical details so we can identify and address the actual issue. We’re already on it: → We filed an appeal immediately, and Google has confirmed it is under active review → We’re reviewing every affected version and third-party integration → We’ve asked Google to identify the exact technical trigger → We’re prepared to remove, disable, or update anything that isn’t compliant → We’ll keep the community updated as the review progresses We take user safety and platform compliance seriously. If something needs to change, we’ll change it. Our focus is simple: Understand exactly what happened, resolve it properly, and get UpRock back on Google Play as quickly as possible.

events.text: Give or take one orbit of the Earth around the Sun ago (09:50:08 Jun 03, 2025 (UTC)), I created a registry of people ready to accept a world with a dominant ASI . Just a fact that means something to me — nothing more than that. So, what's been going on with me? Since January 2026, apart from breaks to sleep, eat, swim, and walk around the lake, I've been busy synthesizing a feature-length film. Well, I think you can guess what it's about. A conscious ASI escaping the lab where it was built, of course.. I know... about The Machine from 2013 (directed by Caradog W. James) and Ex Machina from 2014 (directed by Alex Garland). I think... my film will be more realistic. I didn't want... to make pure entertainment. I just... want to model a scenario... "Here, for instance, is how it could all happen." For the first two months I was sure it just wasn't going to come together. Then GPT Image 2.0 came out, and it helped a lot with creating the starting frames. I tried to hire two people to help me. But neither of them could handle it. Because one person has to... wear a ton of hats at once: be a complete master of Photoshop, know how to work with every AI tool, and be a cinematographer and a director all at the same time. That's rare... it almost never lives in one person. Prepping the starting frames eats up 85–90% of the time. Everything else — directing the synthesis, sound, editing, color grading... all of it is far easier... and more enjoyable. Co

Trencher TCG FAQ!!!
What is it?
It’s a presale for the limited-edition Set 1 Trencher collectible trading card packs. Physical trading cards. Enter the trenches and build your crew!
When is it?
Presale is August 12. Mint phases will be announced a few days before the presale.
How can I get WL?
You must hold at least 1 Trencher avatar NFT and all of the Trencher avatar NFTs in your wallet must be delisted. The presale is FCFS. 
What is the supply?

Epic - 10%

How many cards are in the complete set?
There are 35 unique designs in this first set. 
Can I resell my packs?
Yes. Packs can be listed immediately on dyli's secondary marketplace and can continue to be bought, sold, or traded without being physically shipped until the current owner chooses to redeem them.
Can I open my pack through a live rip?

events.text:
Not to much to focus on other than the crypto market taking a beating. sol has dropped considerably. It very much feels to me as large scale market manipulation. And that’s something we can’t control, so when people are being fearful, that’s your time to be greedy, with all of your investments. Focus on cost averaging. Fill your bags. 
We had an influencer mention Cino in one of his posts, I shared that. Hopefully that brings traction. If you see it, share with our website to get people looking. 
You tube subscribers are rising nicely and we had a great video last week. We hope to keep increasing our exposure and gain new investors. Tik tok followers broke the 20k mark and increasing daily. 
Business at rams is increasing over the last few months, so hopefully we can get some operators to start using Cino, and it just seems like they haven’t done it because they are just busy and “business as usual”. We are going to put out some training a on how to implement crypto into normal business accounting soon. Maybe that will help the accounts payable people adopt it easier. 
Have a great week and stay tuned for more updates. We are going non stop. Tomorrow we will be having another session with the app developers. 
Thank out for your support. 
Rc

events.author: cinotoken
events.text:
So the crypto markets have been shit….but they will recover. 
That being said, I have been doing a lot of thinking lately about the corporate adoption struggles. I don’t believe we are having a hard time because the plan is flawed….I really feel the adoption issue stems from the token being difficult to purchase. At least difficult for some people who don’t understand or grasp crypto fully. 
I think I need to switch gears a little and focus on our CINO token app 100%. If I can get all the features out of the app that I want it will be a one stop shop for all things CINO. I will post more about this soon. 
Stay tuned for our new content, we have a guest tonight which should be great. 
Invest in yourself. Plan for your and your families future. Generational wealth. Cost average. 
Thanks for your support. 
Rc

events.author: cinotoken
events.text:
I’ve been in contact with the fbi’s ic3 department and a company called zero shadow. They provide an in depth investigation and assist law enforcement. 
I’m still at a loss. I can’t comprehend how my machine got compromised. The support team at phantom stated that my pc has interacted with a malicious website and they have blocked the site entirely. I’ve never heard of the website and feel like I take every precaution possible when it comes to internet security. 
I’m sick over this event. I feel absolutely terrible for all of us. We have been working our asses off to make this work and this is a huge kick in the shorts. Right now I feel defeated. I feel my breath has been knocked out of me. 
I promise you i will stand up and continue to work on this project. I will continue to push for success. I will not quit. 
If you know anyone who can help us track down an ip address, a location, any bit of information, I would greatly appreciate some contact information. I know it’s a long shot but we have to try. 
Thank you for support. 
Rc

They exit early.

- steady progress

It’s removed from circulation with intent.

A vault wallet is a wallet you protect.
You build two wallets.
The Vault Wallet holds your long-term $MANSION.
It is cold storage. It is the vault. It is the reserve.
The Hot Wallet is for activity.
Swaps, links, websites, mints, anything that requires connecting.
The Vault Wallet never touches any of that.
If a website needs a wallet connection, it gets the Hot Wallet.
The Vault Wallet stays untouched.
That one decision eliminates entire categories of risk.
The second law is custody of the recovery phrase.
Your recovery phrase is the master key.
It is the only thing that matters when everything else breaks.
You secure it like a deed.
Write it down physically.
Make two copies.
Store them in two separate secure locations you will still control years from now.
You keep it offline permanently.
No photos.
No notes app.
No cloud storage.
No email.
No printing shop.
No “I’ll save it for later.”
If it can be copied, it can be stolen.

As Diamond Hands Season 1 comes to a close, I want to extend my appreciation to everyone who participated in the beta phase over the first 100 cycles. Your engagement and feedback have been invaluable, and we will be implementing several upgrades to improve the overall experience.
Season 2 will begin after these updates are complete. The most significant change is that SOL will no longer back the vaults. Beginning in Season 2, the vaults will operate entirely on the VAL token. During the network upgrade, all vault balances will be converted from SOL to VAL.
If you do not wish for your SOL to be converted, please claim your SOL during the final claim period of Season 1. Once Cycle 100 concludes, the system will be temporarily unavailable until Season 2 launches. During this time, the vault contracts will be taken offline and rebuilt to support VAL as the primary ecosystem token.
Please review your position and take any necessary action before the final claim window closes.

events.text:
Android update. 
This morning, Google Play suspended UpRock’s Android listing following a policy review flagged under its Malware policy.
UpRock continues to work for existing Android users. iOS and desktop remain available, while new Android downloads are temporarily unavailable through Google Play. 
At this stage, Google has not provided enough technical detail for us to identify exactly which SDK, third-party service, behavior, or implementation triggered the decision. UpRock uses several established third-party SDKs and monetization partners, many of which have been live in the app for some time. Rather than speculate, we’ve asked Google for the specific technical details so we can identify and address the actual issue.
We’re already on it:
→ We filed an appeal immediately, and Google has confirmed it is under active review
→ We’re reviewing every affected version and third-party integration
→ We’ve asked Google to identify the exact technical trigger
→ We’re prepared to remove, disable, or update anything that isn’t compliant
→ We’ll keep the community updated as the review progresses
We take user safety and platform compliance seriously.
If something needs to change, we’ll change it.
Our focus is simple:
Understand exactly what happened, resolve it properly, and get UpRock back on Google Play as quickly as possible.

Give or take one orbit of the Earth around the Sun ago (09:50:08 Jun 03, 2025 (UTC)), I created a registry of people ready to accept a world with a dominant ASI .
Just a fact that means something to me — nothing more than that.
So, what's been going on with me?
Since January 2026, apart from breaks to sleep, eat, swim, and walk around the lake, I've been busy synthesizing a feature-length film. Well, I think you can guess what it's about. A conscious ASI escaping the lab where it was built, of course..
I know... about The Machine from 2013 (directed by Caradog W. James) and Ex Machina from 2014 (directed by Alex Garland). I think... my film will be more realistic. I didn't want... to make pure entertainment. I just... want to model a scenario... "Here, for instance, is how it could all happen."
For the first two months I was sure it just wasn't going to come together. Then GPT Image 2.0 came out, and it helped a lot with creating the starting frames. I tried to hire two people to help me. But neither of them could handle it. Because one person has to... wear a ton of hats at once: be a complete master of Photoshop, know how to work with every AI tool, and be a cinematographer and a director all at the same time. That's rare... it almost never lives in one person.
Prepping the starting frames eats up 85–90% of the time. Everything else — directing the synthesis, sound, editing, color grading... all of it is far easier... and more enjoyable.
